newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - OGE Energy unit sells $250 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - OGE Energy unit sells $250 mln debt.

text.p: The following two-tranche debt deal from Oklahoma Gas & Electric Co, a unit of OGE Energy, was priced Tuesday via lead managers Lehman Brothers and Merrill Lynch & Co Inc, respectively, according to market sources.

LAST S&P AA-MINUS SPREAD +25 BPS PUTABLE IN THE
NOTE: The notes were priced at +25 basis points over the 7.25 percent U.S. Treasury note due August 2004.
